` [Highlight start] It is best to avoid mixing melatonin and alcohol [Highlight end] ` . Combining them increases drowsiness and can worsen sleep quality rather than improve it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXnq0wPb-k9lFyg5-_ujbvoyh9JSxqKobgMTv6Ro23i13BideQsG24jVVMYEM_yXXoovWmbOfl9G9zDtYL2cqu5ftLEXIAL3hqItzSKI-qDH2KcdUsbF-dm-650ZoAr1BNKJEWrjMTzN3y37Oi)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2aiWMVdb4IFQa5nnoRHTAsNrnkfYyvP8hB1DEr4my4Mc8CQ69-6IMz_Jl8fxCpDhWavJ2gOLAIoAh0HLfsDSMp7AdWtw4km2gbLm59fOJPHGYKmf9zHYGsTnMVPUslw86J-R0wvW6aiUYYetfxd9ddDb9k1g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXEPblxgA_HQ730xXiIc_b5RN-jRTtbwsvQQm74EihWuv5_Y-w7en5uyEvunN_WqfJt-euMtCWt0qvDDmxx5i7Xyatjm7GADKFYAyAd-4UAbdmA2R6LKDn0h0WxVAAsl0C)

### Key Risks and Effects

- **Heightened sedation:** Both substances slow central nervous system activity, which can cause excessive drowsiness, dizziness, grogginess, impaired thinking, or trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2aiWMVdb4IFQa5nnoRHTAsNrnkfYyvP8hB1DEr4my4Mc8CQ69-6IMz_Jl8fxCpDhWavJ2gOLAIoAh0HLfsDSMp7AdWtw4km2gbLm59fOJPHGYKmf9zHYGsTnMVPUslw86J-R0wvW6aiUYYetfxd9ddDb9k1g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXnq0wPb-k9lFyg5-_ujbvoyh9JSxqKobgMTv6Ro23i13BideQsG24jVVMYEM_yXXoovWmbOfl9G9zDtYL2cqu5ftLEXIAL3hqItzSKI-qDH2KcdUsbF-dm-650ZoAr1BNKJEWrjMTzN3y37Oi)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16p26NIIl7Tvf87vus1IPQvSq5EZaNgzA3CcW6dqXIFhC0Ml-1NGSv8Ssjjne8X6pHZ6s_JChBJVfHJALKAIHJm8tX4Sjpdklotl2-SKu6E2NIIH2Xk1yV7HCa_K8ozp2Rgfect1F0rSGAwESdrwK-9nmtKKNM5c8ciq5wP_)
- **Worse sleep architecture:** Alcohol suppresses REM sleep and causes nighttime awakenings, and melatonin does not reliably fix alcohol-disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXnq0wPb-k9lFyg5-_ujbvoyh9JSxqKobgMTv6Ro23i13BideQsG24jVVMYEM_yXXoovWmbOfl9G9zDtYL2cqu5ftLEXIAL3hqItzSKI-qDH2KcdUsbF-dm-650ZoAr1BNKJEWrjMTzN3y37Oi)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX6vQnS2Q7ltG17dgu1gIRh4DZxlaDKASpWFaXFBISBS4LhnWIR2Pw-DKURXs6OdpKZqNcPB9fw1Qld0MH9vdpGiq3E8jxXbEYt0-lhbuFiZqiEQhUx9EWDoTgih3WrG5dleYC55u2)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXEPblxgA_HQ730xXiIc_b5RN-jRTtbwsvQQm74EihWuv5_Y-w7en5uyEvunN_WqfJt-euMtCWt0qvDDmxx5i7Xyatjm7GADKFYAyAd-4UAbdmA2R6LKDn0h0WxVAAsl0C)
- **Breathing and fall risks:** Relaxed airway muscles can worsen snoring or sleep apnea, and extra sedation raises fall risks—especially for older adults.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16p26NIIl7Tvf87vus1IPQvSq5EZaNgzA3CcW6dqXIFhC0Ml-1NGSv8Ssjjne8X6pHZ6s_JChBJVfHJALKAIHJm8tX4Sjpdklotl2-SKu6E2NIIH2Xk1yV7HCa_K8ozp2Rgfect1F0rSGAwESdrwK-9nmtKKNM5c8ciq5wP_)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2aiWMVdb4IFQa5nnoRHTAsNrnkfYyvP8hB1DEr4my4Mc8CQ69-6IMz_Jl8fxCpDhWavJ2gOLAIoAh0HLfsDSMp7AdWtw4km2gbLm59fOJPHGYKmf9zHYGsTnMVPUslw86J-R0wvW6aiUYYetfxd9ddDb9k1g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX6vQnS2Q7ltG17dgu1gIRh4DZxlaDKASpWFaXFBISBS4LhnWIR2Pw-DKURXs6OdpKZqNcPB9fw1Qld0MH9vdpGiq3E8jxXbEYt0-lhbuFiZqiEQhUx9EWDoTgih3WrG5dleYC55u2)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXz-cwkm7MLYlTRFz4nxWMgSt3YkCc0vIf5sY1UtyXwP0bFlWB84gpMEnMMQyXgHGuMXgciIhgeU60MvjOxFEGoiAGqd1_oWsfZvk33Xmo5JrZMS-P34Ig_KkQ-8A63jQeLTIZ-yEM)
- **Other possible side effects:** People occasionally report headaches, anxiety, vivid dreams, or stomach upset.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXz-cwkm7MLYlTRFz4nxWMgSt3YkCc0vIf5sY1UtyXwP0bFlWB84gpMEnMMQyXgHGuMXgciIhgeU60MvjOxFEGoiAGqd1_oWsfZvk33Xmo5JrZMS-P34Ig_KkQ-8A63jQeLTIZ-yEM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)

For more details on potential side effects and label guidance, see the [Sleep Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2aiWMVdb4IFQa5nnoRHTAsNrnkfYyvP8hB1DEr4my4Mc8CQ69-6IMz_Jl8fxCpDhWavJ2gOLAIoAh0HLfsDSMp7AdWtw4km2gbLm59fOJPHGYKmf9zHYGsTnMVPUslw86J-R0wvW6aiUYYetfxd9ddDb9k1g) and [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw) . On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF13wBewbRdKxOugvi3a7k1y3SICzApOzkGDVodeI0NP-E3EgcUVtlV-FSN3VYgT-ZNlJPgddJAonnWLLmLGrWmu8qrFDKI4CpV1FOcodzTv1ywAfcvhOJngnVDVTXFl3rgVj1Fjpqj3q8KLsR6xDkKSBxuFFfJtIlDLNXO_O-fQI4nAaP5tAppbc7R1yj5-irMuWL8H3f) , opinions are mixed: many users warn against combining them due to next-day grogginess or disrupted sleep, while a few suggest a low dose with a couple of drinks feels mild since melatonin is naturally produced in the body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2aiWMVdb4IFQa5nnoRHTAsNrnkfYyvP8hB1DEr4my4Mc8CQ69-6IMz_Jl8fxCpDhWavJ2gOLAIoAh0HLfsDSMp7AdWtw4km2gbLm59fOJPHGYKmf9zHYGsTnMVPUslw86J-R0wvW6aiUYYetfxd9ddDb9k1g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF13wBewbRdKxOugvi3a7k1y3SICzApOzkGDVodeI0NP-E3EgcUVtlV-FSN3VYgT-ZNlJPgddJAonnWLLmLGrWmu8qrFDKI4CpV1FOcodzTv1ywAfcvhOJngnVDVTXFl3rgVj1Fjpqj3q8KLsR6xDkKSBxuFFfJtIlDLNXO_O-fQI4nAaP5tAppbc7R1yj5-irMuWL8H3f)

### Practical Guidance

- **If you drink:** Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXnq0wPb-k9lFyg5-_ujbvoyh9JSxqKobgMTv6Ro23i13BideQsG24jVVMYEM_yXXoovWmbOfl9G9zDtYL2cqu5ftLEXIAL3hqItzSKI-qDH2KcdUsbF-dm-650ZoAr1BNKJEWrjMTzN3y37Oi)
- **If you take melatonin:** Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXnq0wPb-k9lFyg5-_ujbvoyh9JSxqKobgMTv6Ro23i13BideQsG24jVVMYEM_yXXoovWmbOfl9G9zDtYL2cqu5ftLEXIAL3hqItzSKI-qDH2KcdUsbF-dm-650ZoAr1BNKJEWrjMTzN3y37Oi)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)
- **Check medications:** Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXVA6XJQgxy1UOUKlBgi7wfl3mbdbpFRPlZjtPpCDH7Urv2TJaFXZLMQRfuiCM5XwuLi1mTRwhEH3Ln7aboGQpoMRK6_0IFUniY5orIBeFp0JXNt-W6n6CAEh7DhL9GiaJX6ZpPp951o4HczXxJw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16p26NIIl7Tvf87vus1IPQvSq5EZaNgzA3CcW6dqXIFhC0Ml-1NGSv8Ssjjne8X6pHZ6s_JChBJVfHJALKAIHJm8tX4Sjpdklotl2-SKu6E2NIIH2Xk1yV7HCa_K8ozp2Rgfect1F0rSGAwESdrwK-9nmtKKNM5c8ciq5wP_)

items.title: Practical Guidance
items.text: If you drink: Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again. If you take melatonin: Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective. Check medications: Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.
